description: Never call an item safe. An empty result is not a safety check. Coverage: US, UK, Canada and EU/EEA recalls (US by default). In the US, category 'product' searches CPSC consumer-product recalls by words in the product name (brand plus product type, e.g. 'Rowenta vacuum'); 'food_drug' searches FDA food, drug and medical device enforcement reports (e.g. 'CPAP', 'insulin pump'); 'vehicle' searches NHTSA by make, model and model year. country 'GB' searches UK OPSS product recalls and Food Standards Agency alerts; 'CA' Health Canada; an EU or EEA country (e.g. 'DE', 'France') the EU Safety Gate alerts on dangerous non-food products and vehicles from the last three years. Use when someone asks if a product, food, medicine or car was recalled, is safe to buy or use, or before buying something used. An empty result means none was found, not that the item is safe. Not medical advice.

category.description: product (CPSC), food_drug (FDA food, drugs and medical devices) or vehicle (NHTSA)

country.description: Where the person lives or bought it: United States (default), United Kingdom, Canada or any EU/EEA country

query.description: Product, food, drug or medical device words, for product and food_drug, e.g. 'stroller', 'peanut butter' or 'CPAP'
